plan: My value is $29. Since this is the only round, I want to maximize my expected profit. Given the endowment of $20, I should bid aggressively but not exceed my endowment. I will bid slightly above the maximum possible value ($20) to ensure I win if any other bidder values the item highly. A bid of $20.1 should secure the win against any bidder with a value less than or equal to $20, and I'll still profit if I win against someone valuing it between $20.1 and $29.

My value is $29, significantly higher than the endowment of $20. I need to win, but avoid overpaying. Given it’s the final round, I'll bid slightly above the endowment to almost guarantee a win, but not excessively. I anticipate other bidders may bid close to their endowment. A bid of $20.00 is risky, so I’ll bid slightly higher to increase my chances.

My value is $22, and my endowment is $20. Since my value exceeds my endowment, I should bid my entire endowment. This maximizes my potential profit. Even if I win, I'll only get a value of $22 and pay up to $20, resulting in a $2 profit. Bidding less risks losing to a slightly higher bid and receiving nothing.
